name: Chika no Natsu Shuku! ~Chinko de Hodokou Ero Drill~
original_name: チカのなつしゅく!～チンコで解こうエロドリル～
source:
Chika is in trouble!
Sumer vacation is ending, and she's not done her homework at all!
But she's got an ace up her sleeve; her loli body!
A lolicon could never resist her, and a little homework is a paltry price to pay...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ302967.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
